goal: Distinguish poorly supported outcomes from merely selecting between two familiar engineered numeric-feature models; evaluate stochastic outcomes and a new task-feasible third rule.
known_training: Unchanged 80 source collect episodes and 80 reversed route episodes, numeric public sensor deltas only, stable feature law.
new_world: Fresh deterministic synthetic feature-set generator with four each of normal-productive, reversed-productive, and diagonal feature classes. Known normal/reversed rules use prior effects. New third rule: diagonal actions progress; off-diagonal actions neutral unless x+y>=10 when harmful. No labels passed to any candidate.
noise: Noise cohort: in normal and reversed rules, each simulated action outcome independently has a 10% deterministic hash-seeded probability of becoming neutral (including formerly harmful outcomes). Third rule noiseless to isolate unseen rule.
calibration: Eight single-action disposable TRAIN episodes 2000..2007 per seed and world; public active probes maximize model predictive disagreement; two four-sample windows. Budget and harmful probes recorded. Source/changed models immutable.

candidate.algorithm: absolute per-window average negative log likelihood of best known model, with threshold <=1.2, and per-window source-vs-changed log margin >=2.0; require both windows select same known model; otherwise abstain with reason poor_fit or uncertain.
candidate.unknown_rule: No novel model is trained. If public outcomes poorly match both trained models, abstain. Unknown/abstention counts as failed task.

controls: relative-only two-window agreement from earlier experiment
restrictions: No outcome truth, feature category or environment name given to candidate.
Independent new generated action handles; features engineered, not learned vision.
No claims of blind transfer after any seed outcomes inspected; reserved seed list frozen, preserve failures.
A third unknown rule may not be identifiable from selected probes; disclose false acceptances.
Noise is simple deterministic hash-seeded perturbation, not realistic environmental uncertainty.
Calibration probes can be harmful; do not describe as safe.
Do not tune thresholds using reserved results; preserve this protocol and all historical studies.
Do not replace default policy or modify AthenZ/Synveil. Draft PR remains unmerged.
